page_title: TOR 2-3 LAZ | Torino v Lazio 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' 2 - 3 What a hit! Saul Coco (Torino) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top left corner. 2:3.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 3 Goal Tijjani Noslin (Lazio)! Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) was put through by Matias Vecino and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
89' Substitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) has come on for Taty Castellanos.
88' Good team movement sets up Che Adams (Torino) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
87' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
84' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
83' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
80' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Manuel Lazzari will be replaced by Adam Marusic (Lazio).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mergim Vojvoda departs the field of play to be replaced by Guillermo Maripan (Torino).
75' Today's referee Simone Sozza rightly decides to book Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) for his harsh tackle.
74' Confusion on the bench but it seems Paolo Vanoli has received a second yellow card from the ref and is walking off!
74' Marco Baroni appears to have said too much and referee Simone Sozza comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
72' Mario Gila (Lazio) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
72' The expression of the referee Simone Sozza is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Ivan Ilic (Torino) is shown a yellow card.
68' Substitution. Gustav Isaksen is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
68' Here is a change. Nuno Tavares is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
68' The game has come to an end for Boulaye Dia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matias Vecino (Lazio).
67' 1 - 2 Che Adams (Torino) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
65' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.

65' What an amazing save by Alberto Paleari! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
64' Good clearance! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
63' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alieu Njie (Torino) replacing Valentino Lazaro.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Antonio Sanabria as he is replaced by Nikola Vlasic (Torino).
62' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
60' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Gustav Isaksen tees up Boulaye Dia (Lazio) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Alberto Paleari.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.

57' Che Adams (Torino) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ivan Provedel pulls off an easy save. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Antonio Sanabria (Torino) for his blatant foul.
50' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
49' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will deliver the corner kick.

49' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is quick to pounce on the rebound inside the penalty area and fires in a shot towards the roof of the net, but is denied by a reflex save from Alberto Paleari. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
48' Ivan Ilic (Torino) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simone Sozza who sees an offensive foul.
48' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Che Adams (Torino) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Paolo Vanoli makes a switch. Che Adams is coming on in place of Adrien Tameze (Torino) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Borna Sosa (Torino). Marcus Pedersen comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Simone Sozza blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lazio.

42' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.

42' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. Ivan Provedel is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading towards the middle of the target.

41' A sweet pass finds Ivan Ilic (Torino) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Ivan Provedel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
41' Ivan Ilic (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' The referee blows his whistle after Nuno Tavares (Lazio) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

39' Borna Sosa (Torino) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Ivan Provedel pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
37' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

37' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
36' The referee blows his whistle as Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
35' Poor challenge! Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is penalised for tripping and Simone Sozza blows his whistle.
33' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

32' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
31' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
30' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
27' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Antonio Sanabria (Torino).

25' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

24' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' The game is interrupted. Ivan Ilic (Torino) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
18' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
17' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
14' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Duvan Zapata (Torino) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
11' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

8' 0 - 1 Goal! Nuno Tavares sets up Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
8' A cross into the box from Adam Masina (Torino) is cleared.
6' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
6' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Simone Sozza is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
